claim: Adds Jacobian-informed training to operator approximation for derivative-critical downstream tasks.
claim_zh: 将算子输出与导数/Jacobian信息联合纳入训练。
innovation_detail: Jointly fit operator outputs and derivative/Jacobian information.
innovation_detail_zh: 将算子输出与导数/Jacobian信息联合纳入训练。
bottleneck: Forward surrogate accuracy does not guarantee accurate gradients in outer-loop inverse optimization.
bottleneck_zh: 正向代理预测精度不能保证反问题外层优化所需的梯度精度。
tradeoff: Obtaining derivative labels may introduce additional computational costs.
